reviews.comment: She was a great professor. I enjoyed her class and learned a lot of important things happening in the world. Tests were moderate, but they were open note, and the papers we had to write required a lot of reading, but overall the class wasn't too difficult, if you put in the time to study a little and read the assigned reading you should do well.
